'''2020 TMW Pods Casey Anis LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room (2)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Casey Anis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Stage:''' Pods
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Yavin 4 Massassi Throne Roo Anis L.txt |Download]]
